Fixture — ap-character-cuts.js

Open in a browser. Instance A exercises all three live cuts, the Unsorted cluster (cards with an empty field), the FLIP reorder at --motion-transactional, the 50-card ceiling (60 cards → 10 clipped, "Load more" reveals +50), and ?cut= round-tripping to the URL. Instance B has no data-year on any card, so the Year chip must render disabled + aria-disabled="true" and wire no listener.
